title: Intro to Java
line: Types, methods, classes and collections. Your first Java programs.

project.title: A vending machine
project.brief: Write VendingMachine.java on your own. An Item class, a HashMap of stock by code, and a buy method that throws an exception when money is short or the item is sold out.
checks: VendingMachine.java compiles with javac and runs to the end
Buying a sold out item prints an error and the program keeps going
The final stock report lists every item with its count

lessons.title: Compile and run your first class
lessons.goal: Teach a complete beginner to write Hello.java in VS Code with a class and a main method, compile it with javac and run it with java to print a three-line welcome sign.
lessons.passes: Hello.class exists and running it prints three lines.

lessons.title: Variables and types
lessons.goal: Teach Java int, double, boolean and String variables, arithmetic and casting by building a trip fuel cost calculator in FuelCost.java.
lessons.passes: A 300 km trip at 15 km per litre and 2 dollars a litre prints 40.0.

lessons.title: Strings
lessons.goal: Teach Java String methods, with length, charAt, substring, toLowerCase and equals, by building a username maker from a first and a last name.
lessons.passes: Ada Lovelace prints the username alovelace.

lessons.title: If, else and switch
lessons.goal: Teach Java if, else and switch by writing a rock paper scissors judge that takes two moves and prints who wins or that it is a tie.
lessons.passes: Rock against scissors prints a win for rock, and rock against rock a tie.

lessons.title: For and while loops
lessons.goal: Teach Java for and while loops by printing a savings table that grows 1000 dollars at 5 percent a year for ten years.
lessons.passes: The table has ten rows and the last balance is 1628.89.

lessons.title: Methods
lessons.goal: Teach Java static methods with parameters, return types and overloading by writing a unit converter for miles to kilometres and pounds to kilograms.
lessons.passes: Each conversion is its own method and 10 miles prints 16.09 kilometres.

lessons.title: Arrays and ArrayList
lessons.goal: Teach Java arrays and ArrayList by building a grade book that stores five scores, adds a sixth and prints the highest and the average.
lessons.passes: The grade book prints the highest score and the average of six scores.

lessons.title: Classes and objects
lessons.goal: Teach Java classes with private fields, a constructor, methods and toString by building a BankAccount class with deposit and withdraw.
lessons.passes: A new account prints a balance of 30 after a deposit of 50 and a withdrawal of 20.

lessons.title: HashMap
lessons.goal: Teach the Java HashMap with put, get, getOrDefault and a loop over the keys by counting the votes in a class election and printing the winner.
lessons.passes: The vote counts match the ballots and the winner is printed.

lessons.title: Exceptions
lessons.goal: Teach Java try, catch and throw by writing a calculator that divides two numbers given as text and survives a zero and a word that is not a number.
lessons.passes: Bad input prints an error message and the program ends with no stack trace.
